python_labs.title: Sinusoids and phasors
python_labs.tasks: Plot x(t)=A cos(w t+phi) and its phasor; add 3 same-frequency sinusoids numerically and by phasor sum
python_labs.notes: Proposed Python port (NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib) of DSP First-style labs; not an OSU lab list.

python_labs.title: Spectrum and synthesis
python_labs.tasks: Build a sum of sinusoids / beat note / simple song; plot two-sided spectrum lines; listen via soundfile or IPython.display.Audio
python_labs.check: np.fft.fft of an integer-number-of-periods segment shows peaks at the predicted bins with magnitude A/2
python_labs.notes: Proposed Python port (NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib) of DSP First-style labs; not an OSU lab list.

python_labs.title: Sampling and aliasing
python_labs.tasks: Sample cosines above and below fs/2; predict alias frequency; reconstruct with sinc interpolation
python_labs.check: predicted alias f_a = |f - k fs| matches the FFT peak; reconstruction error small for f < fs/2
python_labs.notes: Proposed Python port (NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib) of DSP First-style labs; not an OSU lab list.

python_labs.title: FIR filters by hand
python_labs.tasks: Write your own fir(x,b) loop for y[n]=sum b_k x[n-k]; impulse and step responses of running average and first difference
python_labs.notes: Proposed Python port (NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib) of DSP First-style labs; not an OSU lab list.

python_labs.title: Convolution and LTI
python_labs.tasks: Implement full convolution (flip-and-slide), check commutativity/associativity, cascade two filters, test linearity and time invariance numerically
python_labs.check: np.allclose(my_conv(x,h), np.convolve(x,h)); conv(h1,h2) cascade equals sequential filtering
python_labs.notes: Proposed Python port (NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib) of DSP First-style labs; not an OSU lab list.

python_labs.title: Frequency response of FIR filters
python_labs.tasks: Evaluate H(e^jw)=sum b_k e^{-jwk} on a grid; plot magnitude/phase; pass sinusoids through and compare steady-state output
python_labs.check: my H matches scipy.signal.freqz(b, worN=w); output amplitude equals |H(e^jw0)| A after transient
python_labs.notes: Proposed Python port (NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib) of DSP First-style labs; not an OSU lab list.

python_labs.title: Nulling and averaging filters applied to sampled signals
python_labs.tasks: Design a nulling filter to remove a tone from audio; L-point averager on noisy data; image edge detection (UPC lab) optional
python_labs.check: removed tone bin drops > 40 dB in FFT; Dirichlet formula equals freqz of the averager
python_labs.notes: Proposed Python port (NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib) of DSP First-style labs; not an OSU lab list.

python_labs.title: DTFT plotting
python_labs.tasks: Compute DTFT of finite sequences on a dense grid; verify boxcar Dirichlet pair, shift and modulation properties
python_labs.check: numeric DTFT equals closed-form Dirichlet expression and freqz; property checks with np.allclose
python_labs.notes: Proposed Python port (NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib) of DSP First-style labs; not an OSU lab list.

python_labs.title: DT Fourier series
python_labs.tasks: Compute DTFS coefficients of a periodic sequence by the analysis sum; resynthesize; relate to DFT of one period
python_labs.check: a_k from your sum equals np.fft.fft(one_period)/N; resynthesis equals original
python_labs.notes: Proposed Python port (NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib) of DSP First-style labs; not an OSU lab list.

python_labs.title: DFT by hand vs np.fft and DTMF decoding
python_labs.tasks: Write O(N^2) DFT (matrix), compare to np.fft.fft; zero padding; decode touch-tone digits
python_labs.check: np.allclose(my_dft(x), np.fft.fft(x)); decoded digits equal the generated sequence
python_labs.notes: Proposed Python port (NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib) of DSP First-style labs; not an OSU lab list.
